'''Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show''' was an animal exhibition displayed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[43 ABY]]. [[Vistal Purn]] was one of the judges for the competitions. Awards were given in categories such as "Most Ferocious in Species," "Most Placid in Show," and "Ugliest in Show." The categories were subdivided by type of creatures. There were at least "Rodent," "Marsupial," "Reptilian," and "Insectoid" divisions.
